s: This article details automating SEO workflows, specifically focusing on identifying and removing problematic URL parameters to prevent spider traps. It outlines a data-driven approach using Botify and client data to implement JavaScript-based solutions for parameter busting.
sub: Automating SEO workflows by switching from development to delivery mode.
Technical storytelling for client meetings and roadmap presentations.
Identifying and mitigating spider traps caused by URL parameters.
Implementing JavaScript PageWorkers for selective URL trimming.
Data analysis using weblogs, Botify crawls, and GSC data to find offending parameters.
